Duoyun Bookstore
LMS
english.shanghai.gov.cn| Updated: March 6, 2024

Duoyun Bookstore, located on the 52nd floor of Shanghai Tower, is a flagship store that serves as a remarkable cultural space. 

Visitors enjoy the atmosphere of Duoyun Bookstore on the 52nd floor of Shanghai Tower. [Photo by GAO ERQIANG/CHINA DAILY]

The bookstore spans 2,200 square metres and houses an impressive collection of 60,000 books. It aims to be a cultural haven, having partnered with Douban.com, a popular reading-themed website in China, with recommendations for highly-rated books.

A woman reads a book in Duoyun Bookstore in Shanghai. [Photo/IC]

Additionally, it features a section dedicated to the esteemed London Review of Books and showcases over 3,500 books in languages other than Chinese.

Aside from being a bookstore, Duoyun also serves as a cultural institution and offers an observation platform overlooking the Lujiazui area and Huangpu River.

In addition, Duoyun Books has established several distinctive branches — Guangfulin branch, Theatre store, and Sinan Books.

The Guangfulin store, housed within historic Haipai architecture; the Theater store, adjacent to the prestigious Lanxin Grand Theater; and Sinan Books, artfully repurposed from a vintage Shanghai-style residence, each beckon as noteworthy destinations for discerning patrons.

Address:

Flagship store: 52/F, Shanghai Tower, Pudong New Area

Guangfulin store: Building 22, No 7 Lane 3088, Guangfulin Road, Songjiang district

Theatre store: No 517 Middle Fuxing Road, Huangpu district

Sinan Books: No 16 Gaolan Road, Huangpu district
